greeting.text: You shouldn't be down here. This whole sub-level is off limits.

choices.text: Come with me. Watch my back.

what_happened.text: Power failed on sublevel three. By the time backup systems kicked in, half the containment logs were already gone.

hired.text: Right behind you. I'm not much of a shot, but I'm a worse hostage.

dismissed.text: I'll hold this spot. Come back for me.

thanks.text: Just be careful. Whatever got out down here didn't come from any of our tanks.
